skill.name: image-outpainting
skill.description: Extend images beyond their original canvas with RunComfy edit models. The skill helps choose Nano Banana 2, GPT Image 2, FLUX Kontext, or brand edit endpoints for aspect-ratio changes, uncropping, and background continuation.
skill.summary: Outpaint still images with RunComfy models while preserving the original subject and style.
skill.author: agentspace-so

content.value_statement: Cropped images often need a wider canvas for banners, social posts, or product layouts. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to outpaint images with RunComfy models while preserving the original subject.
actual_capabilities: Routes simple outpainting requests to Nano Banana 2 Edit by default.
Expands square, portrait, or landscape images to new aspect ratios.
Suggests GPT Image 2 Edit when reference images are needed for style matching.
Suggests FLUX Kontext Pro for high-preservation single-instruction edits.
Provides RunComfy CLI commands with JSON input examples.
Explains when to move from CLI endpoints to ComfyUI workflows for seam control.
limitations: Requires the RunComfy CLI and an authenticated RunComfy account.
Does not perform mask-driven edits inside the existing image area.
Does not support video outpainting workflows.
May need ComfyUI workflows when texture seams or lighting mismatches are visible.

use_cases.title: Create social media crops
use_cases.description: Turn a square image into a vertical or widescreen format while keeping the subject intact.

use_cases.title: Prepare commerce product images
use_cases.description: Extend product shots with matching counters, shadows, and backgrounds for catalog layouts.

use_cases.title: Restore cropped visual assets
use_cases.description: Uncrop portraits or historical images with surrounding context that matches the source.

prompt_templates.title: Basic aspect-ratio extension
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a simple canvas change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Outpaint this image to 16:9. Extend the left and right sides with matching background, lighting, and color. Keep the original subject unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Portrait uncrop
prompt_templates.scenario: Reveal more space around a cropped person or object.
prompt_templates.prompt: Uncrop this portrait downward and slightly to both sides. Continue the clothing, posture, shadows, and background naturally. Preserve the face and visible original pixels.

prompt_templates.title: Reference-style outpaint
prompt_templates.scenario: Use another image to guide the added canvas style.
prompt_templates.prompt: Outpaint the source image to a wide hero banner. Match the surrounding style, palette, and texture from the reference image. Keep the original central object unchanged.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-step quality workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request when a large extension risks artifacts.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a two-pass outpainting workflow. Extend the canvas by about 40 percent per pass, inspect for seams after each pass, and recommend the best RunComfy route.

output_examples.input: A user asks to turn a square product photo into a 16:9 website hero image.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Nano Banana 2 Edit, builds a preservation-focused prompt, and saves a wider image with matching background space.

output_examples.input: A user provides a cropped portrait and a reference image for the desired room style.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends GPT Image 2 Edit because the outpaint needs reference-style matching and layout guidance.

output_examples.input: A user reports visible seams after a first outpaint attempt.
output_examples.output: The skill suggests a smaller second pass or a RunComfy ComfyUI outpainting workflow for stronger boundary control.

best_practices: State the target aspect ratio at the start of the prompt.
Describe the environment, lighting, camera distance, and color palette to continue.
Tell the model to preserve the original visible area exactly.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a large one-step extension when boundary quality matters.
Do not omit the target aspect ratio and expect the model to infer it reliably.
Do not use this skill for internal mask edits or video canvas expansion.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It helps extend still images beyond their original frame using RunComfy edit models.

faq.question: Which model does it use by default?
faq.answer: It uses Nano Banana 2 Edit for most prompt-driven outpainting requests.

faq.question: Can it use reference images?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends GPT Image 2 Edit when reference images should guide the added canvas.

faq.question: Can it fix seams at the boundary?
faq.answer: It can suggest better prompts or smaller passes, but difficult seams may need a ComfyUI workflow.

faq.question: Does it store API tokens?
faq.answer: The RunComfy CLI handles authentication. The skill documents token storage and recommends environment variables for CI.

faq.question: Does it support video outpainting?
faq.answer: No. It is for still images and points users to a separate video outpainting skill.
